title: latvia-offline: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: Translations and UTC conversion are the site's own: The source is in Latvian; "restored by 20:00 UTC" is the site's conversion of the 23:00 local update stamp. The latvija.gov.lv capture from outside Latvia failed with net::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID at 08:19:39Z on 22 Oct, consistent with, but not proof of, the foreign-access restriction.
